parameters.command:
=bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
JOB_ID={{$json.jobId}}
WORK="/tmp/n8n-video-$JOB_ID"
mkdir -p "$WORK/frames"
echo "{{$json.manifestBase64}}" | base64 -d > "$WORK/manifest.json"
python3 - <<"PY"
import json, os, urllib.request
work = os.environ["WORK"]
with open(f"{work}/manifest.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
for frame in data["frames"]:
    idx = frame["frame_index"]
    url = frame["image_url"]
    out = f"{work}/frames/frame_{idx:09d}.png"
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, out)
urllib.request.urlretrieve(data["audioUrl"], f"{work}/audio_input")
with open(f"{work}/meta.env", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(f"FPS={data['fps']}\n")
PY
printf "work_dir=%s\n" "$WORK"'

=bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
WORK=$(echo "{{$json.stdout}}" | awk -F= "/work_dir=/{print $2}")
if [ -z "$WORK" ]; then echo "Missing work directory"; exit 1; fi
source "$WORK/meta.env"
ffmpeg -y -framerate "$FPS" -i "$WORK/frames/frame_%09d.png" -i "$WORK/audio_input" -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r "$FPS" -c:a aac -shortest "$WORK/output.mp4"
echo "$WORK/output.mp4"'
